verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a catalog of 700+ pre-built connectors covering applications, databases, event streams and files. Each connector is maintained by Fivetran, handling schema changes and API updates automatically. The directory lists specific SaaS and database sources, and independent community comments corroborate the breadth of the catalog and the relief from API maintenance. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of per-source depth and quality across the catalog (connector reliability varies, e.g. occasional out-of-sync reports).

support.subject: As a data engineer, I pick from a broad catalog of maintained connectors for the SaaS APIs, databases, and files my company actually uses

citations.quote: Fivetran Connectors | 700+ Data Integration Connectors & Setup Guides
Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
Each connector handles schema changes, API updates, and incremental syncs automatically — no data pipelines to maintain.
no one has as complete a catalog of integration plugs as Fivetran
fivetran is fantastic for not having to deal with a boatload of third parties constant API updates and changes
